summary: Enhance your business acumen with our Data Analysis and Market Research course. Unlock insights to drive growth and make informed decisions today.
lede: Data Analysis and Market Research for Business Growth provides a structured way to turn complex market data into actionable intelligence. You will learn to design research frameworks, validate findings statistically, segment audiences, assess product-market fit, and forecast demand using practical analytical methods. The course covers survey design, customer segmentation, competitive benchmarking, predictive modelling, sentiment analysis, and interactive dashboard development. Using approaches such as CRISP-DM, RFM segmentation, Customer Lifetime Value, A/B testing, and AI-assisted data cleaning, you will develop insights that support market entry planning and sustainable growth, even when budgets, timelines, and datasets are limited.
audienceIntro: This program is specifically engineered for professionals who are responsible for gathering, analyzing, and interpreting market data to drive commercial decisions. It bridges the gap between technical data analysis and strategic business application.
modules: Survey Design and Primary Data Collection
Exploratory Data Analysis and Data Cleaning
Qualitative Analysis and AI Sentiment Tracking
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables and basic formulas (VLOOKUP, IF statements). Familiarity with foundational business metrics (revenue, profit margins, basic marketing KPIs). Understanding of basic statistical concepts (mean, median, standard deviation) is highly recommended. No advanced programming (Python/R) or prior database management experience is required.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
